headline: Why did Fiona the hippo become a global icon?
standfirst: Fiona, the beloved Cincinnati Zoo hippopotamus who captured hearts worldwide after a premature birth in 2017, has died at age nine.
keyPoints: Fiona the Nile hippo died at the Cincinnati Zoo after swallowing a visitor's winter hat.
She was born six weeks premature in 2017, weighing only 29 pounds, and became an internet sensation.
Zoo staff and veterinarians attempted supportive care and alternative treatments to help her pass the obstruction.
Political leaders and fans worldwide expressed grief over the loss of Cincinnati's famous animal icon.

sections.heading: What happened to Fiona at the Cincinnati Zoo?
paragraphs: Fiona, the world-famous Nile hippopotamus at the Cincinnati Zoo, has died at the age of nine. Her passing followed a tragic accident in which she swallowed a winter hat that had accidentally found its way into her enclosure. A visitor had tossed the hat in the air, and a ceiling fan flung it through a small opening into her habitat.

Although Fiona seemed fine initially, she began losing her appetite a few days later. Zoo veterinarians and animal care staff worked tirelessly to save her, attempting various methods to help her digestive system clear the obstruction. Despite their heroic efforts and supportive care, her body could not overcome the blockage, and she passed away.

sections.heading: How did Fiona become a global superstar?
paragraphs: Fiona first captured the world's attention when she was born six weeks premature in January 2017. Weighing a mere 29 pounds, she was about half the weight of the previous lowest recorded birth weight for her species. Her desperate fight for survival played out daily on social media, turning her into an international symbol of resilience.

As the first Nile hippo born at the Cincinnati Zoo in over half a century, she grew up in the public eye. Millions of followers watched her daily activities, inspiring everything from a dedicated ice cream flavor to a character in a local ballet. Political figures, local leaders, and fans across the globe quickly shared heartfelt tributes after hearing the news of her untimely death.

highlight: Fiona captured the hearts of millions and became one of Cincinnati's most beloved icons.
